ICYMI: The victory in the third ODI also sealed Afghanistan’s automatic qualification for the 2027 ODI World Cup. Ireland, meanwhile, will have to go through the 10-team Qualifier. Sitting 12th in the ODI rankings, Ireland needed to sweep Afghanistan 5-0 and then hope West Indies lost both of their first two ODIs in India before the September 30 cutoff. However, those hopes were dashed when the first ODI was washed out.
